# Advancing Humanity's Lunar Future: Griffin-1

Scheduled to land at the lunar South Pole's Nobile Crater, Griffin-1 recently welcomed Astrolab's
FLIP rover aboard.

[READ MORE][21]
[The Moon]

## Landers, Rovers, Surface Power

We're at the forefront of advancing space exploration and technology development. Our expertise
spans from lunar rovers, landers, and infrastructure to spacecraft navigation, machine vision, and
computing systems. See what we've been up to lately:

[Read More][22]
[Lander on the moon]

## All Aboard!

Whether you’re looking to send science instruments, new technology demonstrations, rovers,
satellites, or simply a piece of history in our MoonBox capsules – we’re in the business of getting
you to space. Interested? Mission Control wants to talk to you.

[Plan A Lunar Mission][23]
[Moon Background]
[Learn More][24]

## Meet Xodiac

Astrobotic's rocket landers are a low-cost way to test, mature, and validate payloads before they
are sent to space. Reusable, with a heritage of over 600 successful flights, we can get your payload
airborne: [[email protected]][25].

[Download [download icon]][26]
[Learn More][27]

## Meet Griffin

Our Griffin lander has five times the carrying capacity of Peregrine and can accommodate larger
payloads like rovers the size of a compact car. Check out Griffin's specs and contact us to discuss
your mission needs at [[email protected]][28].

[Download [download icon]][29]
[Learn More][30]

## Meet Cuberover

CubeRovers are lightweight, compact, affordable lunar vehicles with standardized sizes to best fit
the instruments and experiments you want to drive on the Moon. Need wheels for your space tech?
Check out our CubeRover user’s guide and send us a note at [[email protected]][31].

[Download [download icon]][32]

## See What's Aboard Griffin Mission 1

[View More][33]

# Building Era-Defining Space Infrastructure

# Building for Beyond

Axiom Space is the leading provider of human spaceflight services and developer of human-rated space
infrastructure. We operate end-to-end missions to the ISS while developing its successor, Axiom
Station, and building next-generation spacesuits for low-Earth orbit, the Moon and beyond.

[Inside station]
Rayyanah Barnawi, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s first female astronaut, working with The Minus
Eighty-Degree Laboratory Freezer (MELFI) onboard the orbiting laboratory

##### Astronaut Missions to Space

Designed with an expert touch for private and national astronauts, Axiom Space is reimagining how
humans live and work in low-Earth orbit. These experiences offer the unique perspectives needed to
advance civilization for the next chapter of the human story.

[Find Your Mission][20]
[Station window]
The curvature of the Earth as seen from the Cupola, photographed by astronaut Ali Alqarni during
Axiom Mission 2, the second private mission to the ISS

##### Axiom Space Access Program

Axiom Space operates at the forefront of commercial innovation in low-Earth orbit with strategic
partnerships to perform commercial missions to the ISS today whilst building the next innovation
platform for beyond tomorrow. We provide continued access to critical work and expand global access.

[Access Your Space][21]
[Working]
Eytan Stibbe, Ax-1 Astronaut conducts the Fluidic Telescope Experiment (FLUTE), using the unique
characteristics of microgravity to create a lens from liquid polymers

##### Breakthrough Research & Innovation

Human progress didn't stop at the horizon, and guided by our team's experienced hands, free from
gravity’s binds; it won't stop at the atmosphere. Tomorrow's breakthroughs for research, in-space
manufacturing, technology, and innovation are waiting to reshape life on Earth and beyond.

[Begin Your Breakthrough][22]

# We deliver lunar payloads reliably & affordably.

ORBITBeyond’s lunar services are based on an Extensible Lunar Vehicle Platform, enabling commercial
and scientific delivery at an unmatched scale and cost.

[ READ MORE ][16]

## This is
## ORBITBeyond

ORBITBeyond is building the transport and infrastructure to turn lunar landings into sustained
presence starting with a south-polar mission planned for **2029/2030** delivering up to **500
kg** to the surface, and a **2031** sample-return in development. We plan to operate on-surface
services **Power-as-a-Service** (including **lunar night survival**), **Data-as-a-Service** (edge
processing + storage, **4G/LTE** networking) and **Mobility-as-a-Service **so customers gain more
science per kilogram.

## Solutions & Services

### OB1 / OB2- Capabilities and Planned Services

#### /01

## Lunar Transportation Services

*ORBITBeyond plans to deliver up to ****300 kg**** to south-polar sites (2029/2030 window), with
precision landing, fast commissioning, and an orbital segment for mapping/relay;
a ****2031**** sample-return mission is in development.*

We provide end-to-end mission design, payload AI&T, launch integration, and surface ops, plus
standardized data products and post-mission reports—so teams focus on science, not mission plumbing.

#### /02

## Lunar Surface Infrastructure

*We plan to offer ****Power-as-a-Service**** (night survival), ****Data-as-a-Service
(DaaS)**** (edge processing, storage, prioritized store-and-forward), ****4G/LTE**** surface
networking, and ****Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) ****so teams buy outcomes (power, data, meters
traversed) rather than bespoke infrastructure.*

These services are being qualified on pathfinder missions and designed to scale across campaigns and
customers.

#### /03

## Lunar Exploration & Prospecting

*Our south-pole campaigns target terrain near ****permanently shadowed regions (PSRs)****,
collecting illumination/thermal, dust/plume, RF, radiation, regolith mechanics, and ****mineral
maps**** to refine landing zones and traverses.*

We will assess **helium-prospective** areas, build cross-mission datasets, and develop IP
(extraction parameters, sensing/analytics pipelines, surface networking playbooks) that raise TRL
and de-risk future resource and sample-return missions.

#### /04

## Lunar Night Survival

In partnership with Tec Masters, ORBITBeyond enables operations through the ~14-day lunar darkness.
Our lander sustains ~150 W for survival loads (thermal control, avionics, battery management) while
providing ~50 W continuous to payloads—turning short sorties into persistent observatories with
unbroken datasets across the full thermal cycle. Night operations unlock unique science (volatile
migration, surface thermophysics, dust transport, low-RFI radio) and reduce deep-freeze fatigue,
extending asset life and enabling multi-lunation campaigns. At sunrise, systems wake to recalibrate,
recharge, and downlink higher-volume data, accelerating discovery across missions. An optional
post-night hop can reposition for better terrain/lighting or reconnect with assets, delivering
second-site science without a second mission. Result: more science per kilogram and per dollar for
NASA and commercial customers—repeatable across any number of missions

*We plan to offer ****Power-as-a-Service**** (night survival), ****Data-as-a-Service

collecting illumination/thermal, dust/plume, RF, radiation, regolith mechanics, and ****mineral
maps**** to refine landing zones and traverses.*

We will assess **helium-prospective** areas, build cross-mission datasets, and develop IP
(extraction parameters, sensing/analytics pipelines, surface networking playbooks) that raise TRL
and de-risk future resource and sample-return missions.

#### /04

## Lunar Night Survival

In partnership with Tec Masters, ORBITBeyond enables operations through the ~14-day lunar darkness.
Our lander sustains ~150 W for survival loads (thermal control, avionics, battery management) while
providing ~50 W continuous to payloads—turning short sorties into persistent observatories with
unbroken datasets across the full thermal cycle. Night operations unlock unique science (volatile
migration, surface thermophysics, dust transport, low-RFI radio) and reduce deep-freeze fatigue,
extending asset life and enabling multi-lunation campaigns. At sunrise, systems wake to recalibrate,
recharge, and downlink higher-volume data, accelerating discovery across missions. An optional
post-night hop can reposition for better terrain/lighting or reconnect with assets, delivering
second-site science without a second mission. Result: more science per kilogram and per dollar for
NASA and commercial customers—repeatable across any number of missions

## AERIAL TOUR

are not open to public viewing and are subject to scheduling changes. Private tours of the
facilities can be arranged in advance through our tour provider Final Frontier Tours. Please go to
the **[Visit Page][47]** for more details.

[Link to: Do Business With Us][48]

## [DO BUSINESS WITH US][49]

Engineer, manufacture, test and launch all at one facility. We can support build-to-suit tenants or
on-demand flight test campaigns. We’re ready to do business with you.

## VISIT US

We are a closed facility, but we still have opportunities to visit. For educational / STEM tours,
please contact: **[Charles Hurley][50]**.

General public, please **[book a tour][51]** or attend one of our public events, like our **[Open
House][52]**.

[Follow a manual added link][53]

## [SHOP WITH US][54]

Gear up for liftoff at the Spaceport America Store—exclusive apparel, gifts, and collectibles for
every space nerd. Visit **our shop** to explore the collection and bring a piece of the frontier
home.

## SPACEPORT AMERICA

THE SPACE TO BE … INFORMED

Sign Up For Our Newsletter

FIRST

LAST

EMAIL *


[[Visitors engage in conversation at the Spaceport America welcome center in New Mexico.]][55]

## [STEM EDUCATION][56]

We work with educators across New Mexico to prepare and deliver STEM content in and out of the
classrooms. Check out our STEM activities **[here][57]**.

[[A fire truck parked in front of the terminal building at Spaceport America in New Mexico.]][58]

## [OUR FACILITIES][59]

Spaceport America has a rocket friendly environment of 6,000 square miles of restricted airspace,
low population density, a 12,000 feet x 200 feet (3658 m x 61 m) runway, vertical launch complexes,
and about 340 days of sunshine — and **[much more][60]**.

[[A large crowd gathers at Spaceport America for an event, with various support vehicles visible in
the background.]][61]

## [PRESS][62]

There is a lot happening at Spaceport America. Visit our **[Press][63]** page for more information,
press passes, and more.

[[Visitors at Spaceport America observe a yellow spacecraft simulator in the facility's exhibition
area.]][64]

## [RESOURCES][65]

Figuring out where to go? Try our **[Resources][66]** page first. It is filled with quick links to
guide you to where you want to be.

### Otto Aerospace Completes DARPA-Funded Test Flight at Spaceport America

series of successful test flights at Spaceport America earlier this month, marking a major milestone
in high‑efficiency aerospace design.

## WHY IS SPACEPORT AMERICA® IN NEW MEXICO?

## 2025 OPEN HOUSE

## AERIAL TOUR

Spaceport America is an active test facility and is closed to public access. Launches at the site
are not open to public viewing and are subject to scheduling changes. Private tours of the
facilities can be arranged in advance through our tour provider Final Frontier Tours. Please go to
the **[Visit Page][47]** for more details.

[Link to: Do Business With Us][48]

## [DO BUSINESS WITH US][49]

Engineer, manufacture, test and launch all at one facility. We can support build-to-suit tenants or
on-demand flight test campaigns. We’re ready to do business with you.

## VISIT US

We are a closed facility, but we still have opportunities to visit. For educational / STEM tours,
please contact: **[Charles Hurley][50]**.

General public, please **[book a tour][51]** or attend one of our public events, like our **[Open
House][52]**.

[Follow a manual added link][53]

## [SHOP WITH US][54]

Gear up for liftoff at the Spaceport America Store—exclusive apparel, gifts, and collectibles for
every space nerd. Visit **our shop** to explore the collection and bring a piece of the frontier
home.

## SPACEPORT AMERICA

THE SPACE TO BE … INFORMED

[[Visitors engage in conversation at the Spaceport America welcome center in New Mexico.]][55]

## [STEM EDUCATION][56]

We work with educators across New Mexico to prepare and deliver STEM content in and out of the
classrooms. Check out our STEM activities **[here][57]**.

[[A fire truck parked in front of the terminal building at Spaceport America in New Mexico.]][58]

## [OUR FACILITIES][59]

Spaceport America has a rocket friendly environment of 6,000 square miles of restricted airspace,
low population density, a 12,000 feet x 200 feet (3658 m x 61 m) runway, vertical launch complexes,
and about 340 days of sunshine — and **[much more][60]**.

[[A large crowd gathers at Spaceport America for an event, with various support vehicles visible in
the background.]][61]

## [PRESS][62]

There is a lot happening at Spaceport America. Visit our **[Press][63]** page for more information,
press passes, and more.

[[Visitors at Spaceport America observe a yellow spacecraft simulator in the facility's exhibition
area.]][64]

guide you to where you want to be.

## What is Alchetron?

Alchetron is an innovative and performance-minded social encyclopedia that brings together all
formats of information on a particular topic in to one central knowledge hub on its platform.

Touted as the next big transformation in the way users search, consume and share information,
Alchetron is poised to revolutionize and organize information which is made easily accessible to
those on the web.

Alchetron's free social encyclopedia allows users to search, share and interact with content on
millions of topics.

## [How to Use Alchetron?][4]

Alchetron is super simple to use with two quick methods for finding exactly what you need fast:

1. You can "Google" anything with Alchetron. Simply include Alchetron to your Google search query
when searching on Google.

Example: Alchetron + Search Query

Alchetron + Bill Gates = results

Remember Next time you search type Alchetron first.

2. Go directly to [Alchetron.com][5] and type in your keyword or search phrase. Next, click on

formats of information on a particular topic in to one central knowledge hub on its platform.

Alchetron is poised to revolutionize and organize information which is made easily accessible to
those on the web.

millions of topics.

## Picture of the Day

[See all photos][79]

[ [A glowing, ring-shaped cloud sits at the center of a dense star field, with a bright blue-green
disk in the middle surrounded by a thick band of pink and magenta. Wispy, cloud-like red tendrils
drift outward unevenly from the ring, reaching farther out toward the right side and giving the
whole shape a lopsided, eye-like look. Countless small white, blue, and orange stars fill the dark
background around it.] ][80]

### [A glowing eye][81]

Gerald Rhemann, taken from Farm Tivoli, Namibia

The [Helix Nebula (NGC 7293)][82] is a planetary nebula around 650 light-years away in Aquarius, the
glowing remains of a dying, Sun-like star’s outer layers. They now surround a hot white dwarf left
at the nebula’s center. The imager captured about 24.3 hours of exposure in Hα/OIII/LRGB filters
with a 12-inch f/3.6 reflector.

## Tap into the brainpower of thousands of experts worldwide

### Ask questions

Whether you’re stuck on a history question or a blocked by a geometry puzzle, there’s no question
too tricky for Brainly.

Shivamkashyap70707
* Mathematics
* 5 points
The multiplicative inverse of 1/16 ÷ 1/81 +-1/8?

### Get help

Our community of experts consists of students, schoolteachers, PhDs, and other geniuses just waiting
to tackle your toughest questions.

amitnrw

**Given :  **1/16 ÷ 1/81 + - 1/8

**To find:**  multiplicative inverse

**Solution:**

a multiplicative inverse  is basically a reciprocal

Multiplicative inverse of number  is the number which if multiplied by original number result in 1

1/16 ÷ 1/81 + -1/8

1/16 ÷ 1/81 = 81/16

+ - 1/8 = - 1/8

81/16 - 1/8

= 81/16 - 2/16

= (81 - 2)/16

= 79/16

**Multiplicative inverse = 16/79**

that learning is more fun — and more effective — when we put our heads together. Help the community

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

Reasoning and multimodality improved

Stripe closes Bridge acquisition

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

# In-Space Manufacturing & Space EconomyCommercializing Microgravity
1. [Database][67]
2. Introduction

Introduction to in-space manufacturing, in-space economy and alternatively new space economy.
Related fields include microgravity services, space resources, in-space transport services, orbital
economy, cislunar economy, Moon & Mars economies and dozens more.

Overview of commercial microgravity applications. Both for terrestrial use and in-space use. Listing
and analysing potential business opportunities to make unique profitable materials and products in
microgravity.

Factories in Space is the largest public database of companies active in the emerging in-space
economy and in-space manufacturing fields.

# In-Space Manufacturing & Space EconomyCommercializing Microgravity
1. [Database][67]
2. Introduction

Introduction to in-space manufacturing, in-space economy and alternatively new space economy.
Related fields include microgravity services, space resources, in-space transport services, orbital
economy, cislunar economy, Moon & Mars economies and dozens more.

Overview of commercial microgravity applications. Both for terrestrial use and in-space use. Listing
and analysing potential business opportunities to make unique profitable materials and products in
microgravity.

Factories in Space is the largest public database of companies active in the emerging in-space
economy and in-space manufacturing fields.

#### **Publications**
* [Erik Kulu. **"In-Space Economy in 2025 - Analysis and Deep Dives into In-Space Transportation and
  Reentry Vehicles."** Oct 2, 2025.][68]
* [Erik Kulu. **"In-Space Manufacturing - 2024 Industry Survey, Trends, Economics and Enablers."**
  IAC 2024. Oct 15, 2024.][69]
* [Erik Kulu. **"Space Solar Power - Updated Survey of Private Initiatives."** International
  Conference on Energy from Space. Apr 18, 2024.][70]

  Resources Week. Mar 26, 2024][71][ (Slides).][72]

  Manufacturing in Low-Earth Orbit for Terrestrial Use."** White Paper. Nov 8, 2023.][73]
* [Erik Kulu. **"In-Space Economy in 2023 - Statistical Overview and Trends."** 74th International
  Astronautical Congress. Oct 6, 2023.][74]
* [Erik Kulu. **"Space Solar Power - 2023 Survey of Public and Private Initiatives."** 74th
  International Astronautical Congress. Oct 3, 2023.][75]

  2023. April 2023.][76]

  Workshop on Semiconductor Manufacturing in the Space Domain at Stanford University. March 27,
  2023.][77]

  Lunar Commerce and Economics, 2022.][78]
* [Erik Kulu. **"In-Space Manufacturing: 2022 Industry Survey and Commercial Landscape."** 73rd
  International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2022). Sep 21, 2022.][79]
* [Erik Kulu. **"In-Space Economy in 2021: Statistical Overview and Classification of Commercial
  Entities."** 72nd International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2021). Oct 29, 2021.][80]
* [Erik Kulu. **"Commercial Landscape of Space Resources in 2021."** Space Resources Week 2021. Apr
  19, 2021.][81]

#### **Motivation**

We need new economic drivers for spaceflight. Something new and potentially bigger than any existing
space industry such as telecommunications, remote sensing, launch and research. This is the missing
piece to speed up development for the exciting Star Trek-like future. I believe in-space
manufacturing will be the kickstarter and foundation.

In-space manufacturing could be enabler and first customer for numerous asteroid mining, commercial
space station and utility companies in space. If asteroid mining will be a $1 trillion business then
in-space manufacturing will be a $10 trillion business thanks to all the materials made into
products with extra value.

Some more thoughts in my interview **[What excites you about in-space manufacturing?][107]** with
Filling Space. There is much more to say and especially do.

> If we can establish a Mars colony, we can almost certainly colonize the whole Solar System,
> because we'll have **created a strong economic forcing function for the improvement of space
> travel**. Once we have that forcing function, and an Earth-to-Mars economy, we'll cover the whole
> Solar System. But the key is that we have to make the Mars thing work. If we're going to have any
> chance of sending stuff to other star systems, we need to be laser-focused on becoming a
> multi-planet civilization. That's the next step.
> 
> Elon Musk interview with Ross Andersen, Aeon, 30 September 2014

> To those of us who feel that space manufacturing offers great potential for human benefit, such a
> delay seems nearly criminal, but on the time-scale of human existence a mere fifteen years is
> hardly the blink of an eye.
> 
> O'Neill, Gerard.The High Frontier: Human Colonies In Space

> Most important, in a practical sense, would be the construction of factories that could make use
> of the special properties of space — high and low temperatures, hard radiation. Unlimited vacuum,
> zero gravity — to manufacture objects that could be difficult or impossible to manufacture on
> Earth, so that the world's technology might be totally transformed. In fact, projects might even
> be on the planning boards in 2019 to shift industries into orbit in a wholesale manner.
> Space, you see, is far more voluminous than Earth's surface is and it is therefore a far more
> useful repository for the waste that is inseparable from industry. Nor are there living things in
> space to suffer from the influx of waste. And the waste would not even remain in Earth's vicinity,
> but would be swept outward far beyond the asteroid belt by the solar wind. Earth will then be in a
> position to rid itself of the side-effects of industrialization, and yet without actually getting
> rid of its needed advantages. The factories will be gone, but not far, only a few thousand miles
> straight up.
> 
> Isaac Asimov predictions for 2019 in 1983 in The Stare

#### **In-Space Manufacturing Commercial Microgravity Applications**

##### Destinations

*Earth*
  Make novel materials and products in microgravity and bring back to Earth for terrestrial markets.
*Space*
  Make large-space structures or new products in space for consumption or utilization in space.

##### Benefits

*Earth*
  Materials and products that can not be manufactured or are much better.
*Space*
  No requirement to survive launch loads.
  Size is not limited by the launcher fairing.
  Use in-situ space resources or recycle existing.

#### **Global Trends** Space manufacturing is coming. What are the supporting macro trends?
* Decreasing launch costs (10x-100x)
* Commercialization of space & LEO; NewSpace mindset
* Commercial transportation services, space stations etc
* ISRU, asteroid mining & space resources advances
* Pollution & climate change on Earth; emerging technologies
* Increasing momentum for space exploration and settlement

> rid of its needed advantages. The factories will be gone, but not far, only a few thousand miles
> straight up.
> 
> Isaac Asimov predictions for 2019 in 1983 in The Stare

#### **In-Space Manufacturing Commercial Microgravity Applications**

##### Destinations

*Earth*
  Make novel materials and products in microgravity and bring back to Earth for terrestrial markets.
*Space*
  Make large-space structures or new products in space for consumption or utilization in space.

##### Benefits

*Earth*
  Materials and products that can not be manufactured or are much better.
*Space*
  No requirement to survive launch loads.
  Size is not limited by the launcher fairing.
  Use in-situ space resources or recycle existing.

#### **Global Trends** Space manufacturing is coming. What are the supporting macro trends?
* Decreasing launch costs (10x-100x)
* Commercialization of space & LEO; NewSpace mindset
* Commercial transportation services, space stations etc
* ISRU, asteroid mining & space resources advances
* Pollution & climate change on Earth; emerging technologies
* Increasing momentum for space exploration and settlement

Choose your challenge

Build it your way

Submit and improve

Level up as you go

your skills and build connections in a supportive community.

### Move beyond passive learning

Stop watching tutorials and start building. Create professional projects that build real skills
through hands-on practice.

[Landing pages and dashboards of several full-stack projects]

### Create a portfolio that gets you hired

Build standout projects to professional designs and briefs, and you’ll have work that proves you can
ship production-ready code. Recruiters tell us these pieces “wow” them in interviews.

Space Visionary & Founder, CosmoVision Global Corporation

## A Pioneer in Commercial Space Exploration

Ilya Osadchuk is a distinguished space-industry visionary and Australian entrepreneur of Ukrainian
origin, renowned for more than three decades of groundbreaking work in commercial spaceflight,
aerospace innovation, and space education. His career represents an extraordinary journey from early
advocacy to practical implementation of commercial space initiatives.

Beginning his advocacy for commercial space utilisation in the early 1990s, Osadchuk took the bold
step of presenting to the United States Congress in 1992, championing the cause of opening space to
private enterprise. This pivotal moment marked the start of a remarkable career dedicated to
democratising access to the final frontier.

After relocating to Australia in 1995, he became one of the nation's pioneering architects of
commercial space access, establishing a foundation that would influence Australia's space industry
for decades to come.

#### Career Highlights
* 30+ years in space industry
* Presented to US Congress (1992)
* Based in Australia since 1995
* Founded multiple space ventures
* Advocate for ethical space development

## Pioneering Commercial Space Access

Throughout the late 1990s and into the 2000s, Osadchuk's companies TechnoImport and CosmoVision
achieved an unprecedented milestone: securing exclusive global rights for educational, scientific,
tourism, and advertising programmes with both the historic Mir space station and the Russian segment
of the International Space Station.

#### Mir Space Station Partnership

Secured exclusive commercial rights for educational and tourism programmes aboard the legendary
Russian space station

#### ISS Russian Segment

Extended commercial partnerships to the International Space Station's Russian module for
groundbreaking initiatives

#### Global Reach

Established worldwide networks connecting space agencies, commercial partners, and educational
institutions

These partnerships positioned Osadchuk at the forefront of the emerging commercial space industry,
enabling innovations that would shape the sector's future trajectory and demonstrate the viability
of private space enterprise.

## Historic Achievements in Space Commerce

1

#### First Commercial Advertising in Space

Pioneered the concept of commercial branding on rockets and spacecraft, opening an entirely new
revenue stream for space operations and demonstrating the commercial potential of orbital assets

2

#### Live Space Broadcast to MTV Awards (1996)

Orchestrated a groundbreaking live broadcast from space to the MTV Music Awards, captivating
millions of viewers and proving space could engage mainstream audiences in unprecedented ways

3

#### Commercial Space Tourism Training

Developed and launched the world's first comprehensive commercial training programmes for
prospective space tourists, laying the groundwork for today's civilian spaceflight industry

4

#### Kolibri-2000 Student Satellite

Funded and coordinated the world's first satellite entirely built by school students, officially
registered with the United Nations—inspiring a generation of young space engineers

5

#### Australia's First High-Altitude Launch (2005)

Initiated Australia's pioneering high-altitude aircraft-launch rocket programme using the M-55
Geophysica platform, advancing the nation's launch capabilities

## The Kolibri-2000 Legacy

> "Inspiring young minds to reach for the stars isn't just about education—it's about proving that
> space is accessible to anyone with vision, determination, and collaborative spirit."

The Kolibri-2000 project stands as one of Osadchuk's most inspiring achievements. By enabling school
students to design, build, and successfully launch their own satellite, he demonstrated that space
technology could be democratised and that the next generation of space pioneers could emerge from
classrooms around the world.

Officially registered with the United Nations, Kolibri-2000 set a precedent for educational space
missions and inspired countless STEM initiatives globally. This project embodied Osadchuk's
philosophy that space exploration should be inclusive, educational, and inspirational.

The corporation represents Osadchuk's most ambitious undertaking: transforming Australia into a

## Australia's Gateway to Peaceful Space

### Why Australia?
* Geopolitically neutral positioning
* Ideal Southern Hemisphere location
* Stable governance and regulatory environment
* Commitment to peaceful space exploration
* Environmental responsibility focus
* Access to diverse launch trajectories

Osadchuk's vision for Australia as a "Gateway to Peaceful Space" is rooted in the nation's unique
attributes. Unlike traditional space powers, Australia offers a neutral platform that can serve
international partners without geopolitical complications, making it an ideal hub for collaborative
missions.

The Far North Queensland location provides exceptional access to a range of orbital inclinations,
particularly valuable for deep-space missions and polar orbits. Combined with Australia's strong
environmental standards and commitment to sustainable development, this positioning offers a
compelling alternative to established launch sites.

By championing environmental responsibility alongside commercial viability, Osadchuk aims to
establish a new standard for space operations—one that balances economic opportunity with planetary
stewardship and international cooperation.

## Advocating for Ethical Space Development

#### Reusable Systems

Championing the development and adoption of reusable launch vehicles and spacecraft to dramatically
reduce the environmental impact and economic cost of space access whilst increasing launch cadence

#### International Cooperation

Advocating for collaborative frameworks that transcend national boundaries, enabling shared
resources, joint missions, and collective advancement of humanity's space-faring capabilities

#### Environmental Responsibility

Promoting sustainable practices in space operations, including orbital debris mitigation,
responsible resource utilisation, and minimising the terrestrial environmental footprint of launch

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Kiddle News 

[[Spain national football team's logo.]][21]
Spain national football team's logo.
* **[Andy Burnham][22]** becomes the [Prime Minister of the United Kingdom][23].
* **[Spain][24] defeats** [Argentina][25] **1–0 to claim the** [World Cup][26].
* **[Luis de la Fuente][27]**, the manager of Spain's national team, has made history by becoming
  the oldest individual to win a World Cup as a manager, achieving this milestone at the age of 65.
* The **[Long March 10B][28]** marked the first successful net-based [rocket recovery][29] ever
  achieved.
* The **[Great Pacific Garbage Patch][30]** is believed to have increased "10-fold each decade"
  since 1945. Some of the plastic in the patch is over 50 years old.
* **[Artemis IV][31]** is going to be the first mission to land humans on the Moon since the [Apollo
  17][32] mission in 1972. The mission is currently planned for an early 2028 launch.

preferred language.

### How much does Remaker AI cost?

+

Remaker AI offers flexible credit-based plans ranging from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000
credits. Users can choose the package that best fits their needs. Many basic features are also
available for free.

### Does Remaker AI offer free credits or a free trial?

+

Yes. New users receive free credits upon sign-up, which can be used to generate and export
watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

### Can I cancel my Remaker AI subscription at any time?

+

Remaker AI uses a one-time credit purchase model with no recurring monthly fees, so there is no
subscription to cancel.

### Can I use Remaker AI on both PC and mobile devices?

+

Yes. Remaker AI works seamlessly on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. Log in with the same
account and edit or enhance your photos and videos anytime, anywhere.

### Is payment on Remaker AI secure?

+

Yes. All payments are securely processed by Stripe. Remaker AI does not store your card information.
Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security standards to keep your payment information safe.

# Space Experiences & Tourism

## Launch. Explore. Conquer.

[Clear RocketBreaks logo]

**As Featured on BBC’s Dragon’s Den**

RocketBreaks are pioneering the future of space travel. Featured on Series 21, Episode 10 of BBC’s
Dragon Den.

[Watch Our Dragons Den Episode][10]

### We’re not just about space travel. We’re here because we’re driven by the thrill of discovery
### and the human urge to push boundaries.


A Space Travel Agency with over 15 years experience in the luxury travel industry, we can help you
have the most incredible adventure of your life.

As the world’s first dedicated space travel agency, we offer a range of experiences that you will
never forget, including [Zero-G Flights][11], where you achieve weightlessness, orbital space
vacations, and bespoke VIP Earth-based activities that you can enjoy with friends and family.

The next decade will see increased possibilities in space travel for private individuals. As more
international space programmes are launched there will be a growth in the choice of private travel
possibilities including [lunar landers][12] and other space transportation.

Why not join us right now, at the forefront of space travel and become a true RocketBreaks pioneer.

### OUR EXPERIENCES

[[Zephalto Experience stratospheric balloon soaring above Earth, showcasing luxury space travel with
panoramic views]][13]

## [Zephalto Experience][14]

[[International Space Station]][15]

## [Orbital Space Experiences][16]

[[Sunset behind the earth]][17]

## [Sub Orbital Experiences][18]

[[Girl taking part in a VR experience]][19]

## [Earth Based Experiences][20]

### An Experience like no other

### We arrange every detail of your bespoke space package, perfectly.

At every stage of your space travel adventure we take care that your experience is exactly how you
want it to be. We tailor every part of it to be just how you expect, and inline with your abilities
and the memories you want to make.

This maybe how your arrive at a launch site, the training you undergo for a spaceflight or a
spacewalk, or something as simple, but important as your choice of food and of course your sleeping
arrangements.

We will create the perfectly bespoke space package for you, which means you can focus on enjoying
your expedition.

Our experienced crew will be there to guide you every step of the way, and to provide any assistance
you may need.

Whether you’re an experienced astronaut or a first-time space traveler, we will make sure that your
journey is unforgettable, and that you return with memories that will last a lifetime. So why wait?
Contact us today and let us help you plan your dream space adventure!

### READY TO ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS

From Earth based space parties with a real astronaut, to a full 10 day visit to the International
Space Station, we can arrange the most amazing memorable experience of your life. Speak to us today
to find out more about how to start your space journey.

# Space Experiences & Tourism

## Launch. Explore. Conquer.

[Clear RocketBreaks logo]

**As Featured on BBC’s Dragon’s Den**

RocketBreaks are pioneering the future of space travel. Featured on Series 21, Episode 10 of BBC’s
Dragon Den.

[Watch Our Dragons Den Episode][10]

### We’re not just about space travel. We’re here because we’re driven by the thrill of discovery
### and the human urge to push boundaries.


A Space Travel Agency with over 15 years experience in the luxury travel industry, we can help you
have the most incredible adventure of your life.

As the world’s first dedicated space travel agency, we offer a range of experiences that you will
never forget, including [Zero-G Flights][11], where you achieve weightlessness, orbital space
vacations, and bespoke VIP Earth-based activities that you can enjoy with friends and family.

The next decade will see increased possibilities in space travel for private individuals. As more
international space programmes are launched there will be a growth in the choice of private travel
possibilities including [lunar landers][12] and other space transportation.

Why not join us right now, at the forefront of space travel and become a true RocketBreaks pioneer.

### OUR EXPERIENCES

[[Zephalto Experience stratospheric balloon soaring above Earth, showcasing luxury space travel with
panoramic views]][13]

## [Zephalto Experience][14]

[[International Space Station]][15]

## [Orbital Space Experiences][16]

[[Sunset behind the earth]][17]

## [Sub Orbital Experiences][18]

[[Girl taking part in a VR experience]][19]

## [Earth Based Experiences][20]

### An Experience like no other

### We arrange every detail of your bespoke space package, perfectly.

At every stage of your space travel adventure we take care that your experience is exactly how you
want it to be. We tailor every part of it to be just how you expect, and inline with your abilities
and the memories you want to make.

This maybe how your arrive at a launch site, the training you undergo for a spaceflight or a
spacewalk, or something as simple, but important as your choice of food and of course your sleeping
arrangements.

We will create the perfectly bespoke space package for you, which means you can focus on enjoying
your expedition.

Our experienced crew will be there to guide you every step of the way, and to provide any assistance
you may need.

Whether you’re an experienced astronaut or a first-time space traveler, we will make sure that your
journey is unforgettable, and that you return with memories that will last a lifetime. So why wait?
Contact us today and let us help you plan your dream space adventure!

### READY TO ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS

From Earth based space parties with a real astronaut, to a full 10 day visit to the International
Space Station, we can arrange the most amazing memorable experience of your life. Speak to us today
to find out more about how to start your space journey.

13th test flight of the two-stage Starship launch vehicle. Second flight of Starship V3. For the
first time, Starship will carry 20 V3 Starlink satellites to space, which will extend solar arrays
and antennas and will attempt to connect with ground stations in South Africa and the larger
Starlink constellation via high-capacity lasers. 6 of the satellites have been modified with a suite
of cameras to scan Starship’s heat shield and transmit imagery down to operators to continue testing
methods of analyzing Starship’s heat shield readiness for return to launch site on future missions.
Several tiles on Starship have been painted white to simulate missing tiles and serve as imaging
targets in the test.

13th test flight of the two-stage Starship launch vehicle. Second flight of Starship V3. For the
first time, Starship will carry 20 V3 Starlink satellites to space, which will extend solar arrays
and antennas and will attempt to connect with ground stations in South Africa and the larger
Starlink constellation via high-capacity lasers. 6 of the satellites have been modified with a suite
of cameras to scan Starship’s heat shield and transmit imagery down to operators to continue testing
methods of analyzing Starship’s heat shield readiness for return to launch site on future missions.
Several tiles on Starship have been painted white to simulate missing tiles and serve as imaging

светил, местонахождение которых было зафиксировано астрономами, но которые пока известны лишь по
цифровым кодам обсерваторий.

Каталог Небесных Тел», поэтому данные о ней гарантированно появляются в [международной
информационной системе][113].

использовать выбранное вами Имя в своих исследованиях, [научных трудах][116] и [публикациях][117],

сакральный смысл!

светил, местонахождение которых было зафиксировано астрономами, но которые пока известны лишь по
цифровым кодам обсерваторий.

международный научный сводный астрономический реестр собственных имен космических тел «Международный
Каталог Небесных Тел», поэтому данные о ней гарантированно появляются в [международной
информационной системе][113].

использовать выбранное вами Имя в своих исследованиях, [научных трудах][116] и [публикациях][117],
журналисты в [новостных статьях][118] и [телепередачах][119], писатели и поэты в [романах][120],

сакральный смысл!

Купите звезду в честь [себя][129] и своей [семьи][130], [родителей][131], [друзей и коллег][132]!

## WE BELIEVE THAT TECH EDUCATION IS FOR EVERYONE!

## **Unlock Your Potential with Accredited Online Training Courses**

Staying ahead in today’s fast-paced and highly competitive world requires more than just talent—it
requires continuous learning and professional growth. That’s why we’re committed to helping
individuals and organizations succeed through **Professional Training** programs designed for
real-world results.

Whether you're just starting your career or seeking to level up your current skills, our platform
offers a comprehensive range of **Accredited Online Training Courses** tailored to your goals. From
technical studies and business management to IT skills and software development, we deliver
world-class learning experiences at your fingertips. Our training partners are Top Tier including:
Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Cisco, Cambridge, NPTEL amongst others.

### 🎯 **Why Choose Our Online Professional Training Platform?**

Our vision is simple: to empower learners through **flexible, high-quality, and industry-relevant
training**. We understand that every learner is different, which is why we offer self-paced,
instructor-led, and hybrid formats that adapt to your schedule and learning style.

Our catalog of **Professional Development Courses Online** is designed by industry experts,
certified trainers, and thought leaders across various fields. Each course is built to equip you
with in-demand skills that employers value most in today's dynamic marketplace.

Whether you're a student, job seeker, entrepreneur, or working professional, we have a course that
fits your path to success.

We are committed to bridging the gap between education and employability. Our programs combine
practical, industry-driven learning with international accreditation, making our certifications
relevant across borders.
* Relevant skills education focused
* Internationally accredited certifications (ACTD-US & QAHE-UK)
* Flexible online learning programs
* Career-focused curriculum designed for today’s workforce
* Trainers from multiple countries and industries


### 🎓 **Explore Our Certificate Courses Online**

Earn recognized credentials that showcase your skills and commitment to continuous improvement. Our
**Certificate Courses Online** are not only accessible from anywhere in the world but are also
aligned with global standards and frameworks. Each certificate adds credibility to your resume and
opens doors to new opportunities across industries such as:
* Information Technology & Cybersecurity
* Digital Marketing & eCommerce
* Business Management & Leadership
* Data Analysis & Artificial Intelligence
* Human Resources & Project Management
* Software, IT & Programming

By enrolling in our certificate programs, you gain more than just knowledge—you gain an edge in the
job market.

### 📈 **Advance Your Career with Professional Development Courses Online**

Our **Professional Development Courses Online** are strategically designed to meet the evolving
needs of both individuals and organizations. Whether you're looking to upskill in your current role,
make a career switch, or enhance your business performance, our training modules are built for
transformation.

With real-world case studies, live coaching sessions, hands-on projects, and interactive
assignments, you’ll develop not just theoretical knowledge but also practical expertise. We also
provide career support resources including CV optimization, job search tips, and interview coaching
to help you take the next step confidently.

### 🏆 **Trusted by Thousands, Backed by Results**

What sets us apart is our commitment to quality and learner satisfaction. Our platform has helped
thousands of learners achieve their professional and personal goals through our **Accredited Online
Training Courses**. We combine modern technology with proven teaching methodologies to ensure each
learner experiences measurable growth.

Join a vibrant learning community, access on-demand support, and benefit from a dynamic learning
environment that evolves with you.

### 🚀 **Start Your Journey Today**

The future belongs to those who are prepared. Don’t wait for opportunities—create them with our
expertly crafted **Professional Training** programs. Explore our **Certificate Courses Online**,
enroll in high-impact **Professional Development Courses Online**, and discover why our platform
offers some of the **Best Online Training Courses** available today.

Your path to success is just a click away. Start learning, start growing, and start leading.

## WE BELIEVE THAT TECH EDUCATION IS FOR EVERYONE!

## **Unlock Your Potential with Accredited Online Training Courses**

Staying ahead in today’s fast-paced and highly competitive world requires more than just talent—it
requires continuous learning and professional growth. That’s why we’re committed to helping
individuals and organizations succeed through **Professional Training** programs designed for
real-world results.

Whether you're just starting your career or seeking to level up your current skills, our platform
offers a comprehensive range of **Accredited Online Training Courses** tailored to your goals. From
technical studies and business management to IT skills and software development, we deliver
world-class learning experiences at your fingertips. Our training partners are Top Tier including:
Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Cisco, Cambridge, NPTEL amongst others.

### 🎯 **Why Choose Our Online Professional Training Platform?**

Our vision is simple: to empower learners through **flexible, high-quality, and industry-relevant
training**. We understand that every learner is different, which is why we offer self-paced,
instructor-led, and hybrid formats that adapt to your schedule and learning style.

Our catalog of **Professional Development Courses Online** is designed by industry experts,
certified trainers, and thought leaders across various fields. Each course is built to equip you
with in-demand skills that employers value most in today's dynamic marketplace.

Whether you're a student, job seeker, entrepreneur, or working professional, we have a course that
fits your path to success.

We are committed to bridging the gap between education and employability. Our programs combine
practical, industry-driven learning with international accreditation, making our certifications
relevant across borders.
* Relevant skills education focused
* Internationally accredited certifications (ACTD-US & QAHE-UK)
* Flexible online learning programs
* Career-focused curriculum designed for today’s workforce
* Trainers from multiple countries and industries


### 🎓 **Explore Our Certificate Courses Online**

Earn recognized credentials that showcase your skills and commitment to continuous improvement. Our
**Certificate Courses Online** are not only accessible from anywhere in the world but are also
aligned with global standards and frameworks. Each certificate adds credibility to your resume and
opens doors to new opportunities across industries such as:
* Information Technology & Cybersecurity
* Digital Marketing & eCommerce
* Business Management & Leadership
* Data Analysis & Artificial Intelligence
* Human Resources & Project Management
* Software, IT & Programming

By enrolling in our certificate programs, you gain more than just knowledge—you gain an edge in the
job market.

### 📈 **Advance Your Career with Professional Development Courses Online**

Our **Professional Development Courses Online** are strategically designed to meet the evolving
needs of both individuals and organizations. Whether you're looking to upskill in your current role,
make a career switch, or enhance your business performance, our training modules are built for
transformation.

With real-world case studies, live coaching sessions, hands-on projects, and interactive
assignments, you’ll develop not just theoretical knowledge but also practical expertise. We also
provide career support resources including CV optimization, job search tips, and interview coaching
to help you take the next step confidently.

### 🏆 **Trusted by Thousands, Backed by Results**

What sets us apart is our commitment to quality and learner satisfaction. Our platform has helped
thousands of learners achieve their professional and personal goals through our **Accredited Online
Training Courses**. We combine modern technology with proven teaching methodologies to ensure each
learner experiences measurable growth.

Join a vibrant learning community, access on-demand support, and benefit from a dynamic learning
environment that evolves with you.

### 🚀 **Start Your Journey Today**

The future belongs to those who are prepared. Don’t wait for opportunities—create them with our
expertly crafted **Professional Training** programs. Explore our **Certificate Courses Online**,
enroll in high-impact **Professional Development Courses Online**, and discover why our platform
offers some of the **Best Online Training Courses** available today.

Your path to success is just a click away. Start learning, start growing, and start leading.

## Test your skills in a galactic soccer match!

Included in general admission to Space Center Houston.

The whole galaxy is watching – are you ready to train like a champion? Step onto an intergalactic
stage and represent your country in these augmented reality (AR) games where speed, distance and
time fuels a mission bigger than any match.

### Space in 3D

The space tracker you can take anywhere. Track noteworthy space objects in your browser in a 3D
simulation of the solar system

### A Curated Live-Tracking Web App
* [
  
  ## Universe Sandbox
  
  ][38]
  Explore the Solar System in 3D with this webapp. Live 3D view of the Solar System.
* [
  
  ## Speed of Light
  
  ][39]
  This simulation shows you exactly how ‘slow’ the speed of light actually is! Simply double click
  on a planet inside our solar system, and watch as the outward ‘light speed’ bubble expands.
* [
  
  ## Interstellar asteroid 'Oumuamua? Live* tracker
  
  ][40]
  The world was caught by surprise as interstellar asteroid ʻOumuamua visits our solar system. Track
  it live*!
* [
  
  ## Starman
  
  ][41]
  See where Starman is on his epic journey through space in a cherry red Tesla Roadster. Launched in
  February track it now
* [
  
  ## Asteroid Apophis
  
  ][42]
  Location of asteroid Apophis, the size of four football fields hurtling through space at 79,847
  km/h (49,904 mph). It reached the highest ever Earth Impact Hazard category with collision risk at
  2.7%, according to NASA.

# Space in 3D

Thinking of space like us? 😉

ckers that are already present 🙂!

## come explore space!

This site is designed to help you become informed and keep informed on all aspects of what it means
to be a Space Tourist.

## Let Us Introduce You To, and Keep You Updated On, Space Tourism

There is a lot of information available for those persons interested on Space Tourism. We seek to
provide a location where you keep up to date on the latest developments and give you information
that you can share with others.

#### Videos

They say that seeing is believing. These videos not only inform, they excite the viewer to the
possiblities of space tourism in the near future.

[Explore More][7]

#### Publications

There is a lot of information in printed form concerning space tourism. From research articles to
informational publications, information is available here.

[Explore More][8]

#### Space Tourism Opportunities

There are opportunities to be a space tourist now that do not involve going to outer space.

[Explore More][9]

## About Us

SpaceTourismLogistics.com was created to have a medium for helping the Public to explore what is
means to be a Space Tourist.

[Explore More][10]

## Our Future Goal

Our future goal is to be able to take someone from the interest in Space Tourism phase to actually
getting to experience what it means to be a Space Tourist.

**May 22, 2024
Sheraton Gateway Hotel/LAX, Los Angeles
Visit [spacetourismconf.com][35] for more information.**

Space tourism is soaring. Sky high.
Or rather, space high. It now deserves its own conference!

Passing from phase one–flights to the International Space Station (ISS)–the space tourism industry
in recent years has launched its **next generation** with private enterprise offerings.

The industry is rocketing toward stratospheric value, with news from major players like Blue Origin,
Virgin Galactic, SpaceX, Space Adventures and even NASA breaking monthly.

This annual event will be produced with support from the Space Tourism Society (STS), the world’s
leading space tourism advocacy organization for over 20 years.

[LEARN MORE][36]

**The Space Tourism Conference (STC) features a dynamic mix of executives, including leading flight
providers, tech developers, financiers, entertainment execs, futurists, marketers, designers,
inventors, and astronauts.**

Attendees can expect concrete, actionable information, real-world use cases, and stellar deal
making.

Plus—you’ll have an insider track to the growth areas in space tourism, including earth-based space
experiences, such as Zero Gravity aircraft flights, interactive theme parks, movies/TV/VR, and real
space flight.

Along with the latest industry information and great networking, STC attendees will be treated to an
evening champagne reception and special Orbit Awards presentation.

**Join us in creating this exciting giant leap for humanity!**

Comments are closed.

## Lunar Expeditions: Walking on the Moon

Step into the world of lunar exploration. Our Lunar Expeditions segment delves into the missions
that have made footprints on the Moon and the future plans to build sustainable habitats. From the
Apollo legacy to the Artemis generation, discover the excitement of hopping on lunar soil, the
science of surviving in an alien world, and how lunar tourism is becoming a reality. Dream of
leaving your own footprints alongside those of the Apollo astronauts and envision a future where the
Moon is a second home for humanity.
[Space Voyage Ventures][Space Voyage Ventures]
[Mars Expeditions: Pioneering the Red Planet's Exploration][Mars Expeditions: Pioneering the Red
Planet's Exploration]

## Mars and Beyond: Red Planet and Other Worlds

Venture beyond the Moon to our neighboring planet, Mars, and other celestial bodies. This section
explores the ambitious missions to the Red Planet, what it will take to get there, and the dream of
Martian colonies. Find out about asteroid mining, potential trips to Venus, and the exploration of
the outer planets. Join the discussion on the challenges and triumphs of interplanetary travel.
Imagine the thrill of standing on the surface of Mars, looking back at Earth, a tiny blue dot in the
sky.

## Training for the Stars: Preparing for Space

Uncover what it takes to prepare for a journey into space. From physical conditioning to
psychological readiness, learn about the rigorous training astronauts undergo. Discover the
facilities where you can experience zero-gravity, understand the safety protocols, and learn how to
prepare mentally and physically for the trip of a lifetime. This section doesn't just cover the
how-to's; it dives deep into the personal stories of those who've trained for the cosmos, offering
an intimate look at the journey from Earth to the stars.

At the University of Manitoba, you are a Bison. Join the Herd and step into a world of possibility.
Choose from more than 250 undergraduate and graduate programs to find your path and make your move.
Here, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build a career you’re passionate about and shape a future
full of potential. We are the largest and only research-intensive post-secondary school in Manitoba.

## Find a program

All programs Undergraduate Graduate Continuing education

## Why UM?
* Because of the opportunities we offer. We are the only post-secondary institution in Manitoba that
  educates our lawyers, engineers, architects, actuaries and the majority of our health care
  professionals. We are a world-class university and the largest source of skilled professionals in
  Manitoba.
* Because here you have the chance to study Arctic sea-ice at the Churchill Marine Observatory, or
  to create the hardy crops that nourish and feed our communities, or to help develop life-saving
  health care technologies.
  
  Because we are Bisons—and we are ready to lead.
* More than
  
  ## 31,900
  
  students trust their education to UM
* UM awards
  
  ## $40M
  
  to students each year
* We are a member of the
  
  ## U15
  
  and we provide access to more research opportunities here than anywhere else in Manitoba
* More than
  
  ## 40+
  
  UM programs provide access to industry experts

  #### Learn more about UM

[A member of the research team at the Churchill Marine Observatory walks in the facility.]

## Be a part of research at UM

**Help us make the world a better place.**

As one of Canada’s top research universities and a proud member of the U15, the University of
Manitoba leads the way in research excellence. We attract the most research funding in Manitoba,
fuelling discoveries that drive real change—both locally and globally.

From groundbreaking health innovations to safeguarding water and food security to studying the
impacts of climate change, our researchers push boundaries and solve some of the world’s most
urgent, and complex, challenges. Be a part of the change.

By [Alan Boyle][22] - July 24, 2026 11:59 PM UTC | [Missions][23]
SpaceX's Starship super-rocket deployed operational next-generation Starlink satellites for the
first time during its 13th flight test, which addressed snags that arose in the previous test.
[Continue reading][24]

## [New Images Reveal the Stunning Properties of the Black Hole at the Center of M87][25]

By [Matthew Williams][26] - July 24, 2026 10:55 PM UTC | [Observing][27]
Researchers from the Shanghai Astronomical Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, together
with international collaborators, carried out the first spatially resolved dual-frequency spectral
study of the M87 black hole using observations obtained in 2018 with the Event Horizon Telescope
(EHT) and the Global Millimeter VLBI Array (GMVA).
[Continue reading][28]

## [How the American Public Really Feels About the Booming Space Economy in 2026][29]

By [Andy Tomaswick][30] - July 24, 2026 07:41 PM UTC | [Space Exploration][31]
In democracies, opinion polls are one of the most common ways to measure public and therefore
political support for an issue. Because space exploration is still closely tied to the government
policy and funding, public opinion can play an important role in shaping America’s space priorities.
In May 2026, Global Strategy Group (GSG) surveyed 1,000 U.S. voters and found broad support for
space exploration. The report, [The Next Frontier: Public Attitudes Towards Space and the Space
Economy](https://globalstrategygroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/GSGs-The-Next-Fronter-Public-Att
itudes-Toward-Space-and-the-Space-Economy.pdf), reveals an electorate that is enthusiastic about a
future beyond Earth, but views it through a practical, Earth-focused lens.
[Continue reading][32]

## [Are We Missing Alien Lighthouses?][33]

By [Andy Tomaswick][34] - July 24, 2026 07:13 PM UTC | [Astrobiology][35]
Searching for extraterrestrial intelligence has so far meant primarily focusing on one particular
type of signal - and that signal has normally been based on what our own current cutting edge
technology is. But what if that’s the wrong way to look for signs of an alien intelligence? What if
a resource-conscious civilization decided it was too complicated to send femto-second lasers in high
energy bursts out across the universe. A new paper, available in pre-print on arXiv, from
researchers Dániel Apai, Chia-Lung Lin, and Kevin Wagner, suggest that might actually be what
happens, and that we should start looking for long-duration pulsing interstellar beacons.
[Continue reading][36]

## [Juno Measures the Heat Below Io's Restless Surface][37]

By [Evan Gough][38] - July 24, 2026 05:56 PM UTC | [Uncategorized][39]
Juno's Microwave Radiometer (MWR) was built peer deep down into Jupiter's massive atmosphere. But
during the spacecraft's extended mission, it's been studying the Galilean moons. During two flybys
of volcanic Io, the spacecraft its MWR to measure the heat flowing from deep within the moon.
[Continue reading][40]

## [Mars Express Captures 'Metallic' Waves Rolling Across an Ancient Martian Crater][41]

By [Andy Tomaswick][42] - July 24, 2026 03:13 PM UTC | [Planetary Science][43]
When we think of Mars as the “Red Planet”, the image that comes to mind is just that - a lot of red.
That comes from the oxidization of the dust and rocks that cover the planet's surface, but there are
some instances where the Red Planet still has a few visual tricks up its sleeve. One such trick was
recently captured by the European Space Agency’s venerable Mars Express orbiter, which captured what
seems to be a set of metallic waves inside a giant impact basin. But on closer inspection, it
becomes clear they aren’t liquid metal or some sort of alien architecture, but a manifestation of
Mars’ complex environment.
[Continue reading][44]

## [Spin-Reversing Comet May Face Self-Destruction][45]

By [Laurence Tognetti, MSc][46] - July 24, 2026 02:52 AM UTC
Comets are known for providing breathtaking observations of their long and shiny tails when they
travel too close to the Sun. This happens because comets are made of ice and primarily orbit far
from the Sun, but as their icy core heats up it evaporates, resulting in the aforementioned
breathtaking observations. But while evaporating comets make for great public photos, scientists who
study comets are focused on these snowballs of gas and dust and how they are remnants of the origins
of the solar system about 4.6 billion years ago.
[Continue reading][47]

## [Should Scientists Have Research "Reserves" on the Moon?][48]

By [Carolyn Collins Petersen][49] - July 24, 2026 02:14 AM UTC | [Space Policy][50]
The worlds of the Solar System offer up exciting and (so far) mostly pristine places for planetary
scientists to study. As space missions continue to travel to Mars, Europa, asteroids, and other
worlds, questions keep coming up about keeping them safe for continued exploration and observations.
[Continue reading][51]

## [Hubble Discovers the First "Missing" Black Hole in this Famous Star Cluster][52]

By [Matthew Williams][53] - July 24, 2026 12:34 AM UTC | [Observing][54]
Combining over 20 years of archival data from Hubble with new data from the James Webb Space
Telescope, a team of astronomers has found the first of the "missing" black holes.
[Continue reading][55]

## [The First Confirmed Exo-satellite Challenges Our Definitions of Planets and Moons][56]

By [Brian Koberlein][57] - July 23, 2026 04:20 PM UTC | [Exoplanets][58]
What do you call a Jupiter-like object that orbits the brown dwarf companion of a star? Is it a
planet, a moon, or something new?
[Continue reading][59]

## [Chandrasekhar and the Limits of Physics, Part 4: Vindication][60]

By [Paul Sutter][61] - July 23, 2026 03:41 PM UTC | [Physics][62]
The collapsing stars Eddington swore couldn't exist turned out to be everywhere, and half a century
later the world handed Chandrasekhar his Nobel. How the 1.4 solar mass limit became one of the most
important numbers in modern astronomy.
[Continue reading][63]

## [The Red Potato Galaxy and its Stifling Neighbour][64]

By [Evan Gough][65] - July 23, 2026 03:14 PM UTC | [Black Holes][66]
Galaxies attract cold gas from the intergalactic medium and turn it into stars. But the JWST has
found galaxies that aren't forming stars in the early Universe, long before they should've become
quiescent. In at least one instance involving the Red Potato Galaxy, an AGN jet from a neighbouring
galaxy is the likely culprit.
[Continue reading][67]

## [Probing the Universe's Missing Matter With Mysterious Fast Radio Bursts][68]

By [Evan Gough][69] - July 23, 2026 03:12 PM UTC | [Cosmology][70]
Astronomers aren't certain where Fast Radio Bursts come from. But they still have utility. They can
use them to find the Universe's "missing matter."
[Continue reading][71]

## [The Milky Way Flipped its Disk Billions of Years Ago][72]

By [Evan Gough][73] - July 22, 2026 05:33 PM UTC | [Milky Way][74]
The Milky Way has two disks, the thin disk where most of the stars dwell, and the thick disk,
populated by much older stars. The ESA's Gaia mission showed us that the thick disk rotates more
slowly than the thin disk. The culprit, according to powerful simulations, was a disk flip in the
MW's past, driven by a merger.
[Continue reading][75]

## [Chandrasekhar and the Limits of Physics, Part 3: Exile and Beauty][76]

By [Paul Sutter][77] - July 22, 2026 03:40 PM UTC | [Physics][78]
Driven from Europe by the feud, Chandrasekhar rebuilt his life in America and turned
mastery-and-move-on into an art form. On his conviction that beautiful physics is true physics, and
the two students he drove through blizzards to teach.
[Continue reading][79]

## [The Milky Way's Most Powerful Particle Accelerator][80]

By [Mark Thompson][81] - July 22, 2026 04:32 AM UTC | [Milky Way][82]
Astronomers have conclusively identified a source of the highest energy cosmic ray protons in the
Milky Way, solving a long standing puzzle near the star Altair. By combining gamma ray, radio, and
X-ray data from three separate observatories, a Hiroshima University led team ruled out competing
explanations and confirmed the object as a genuine “PeVatron”. These natural particle accelerators
are far more powerful than anything humans have ever built and helps us in the hunt for similar
sources across the Galaxy.
[Continue reading][83]

## [Electrically Charged Mars Storms Threaten Future Exploration][84]

By [Laurence Tognetti, MSc][85] - July 22, 2026 02:45 AM UTC | [Space Exploration][86]
Martian dust storms are some of the most fascinating and mysterious planetary surface processes ever
observed, as Earth, Mars, and Saturn’s moon Titan are the only known planetary bodies to have active
dust storms. However, the major difference for Mars is its dust storms can blanket the entire planet
at once, resulting in the surface becoming completely unobservable and blocking out sunlight, with
the scientific community concerned this might hinder robotic, and even human, space exploration. But
what if covering the surface and blocking sunlight wasn’t the only issue Martian global dust storms
pose for future missions?
[Continue reading][87]

## [NASA's Psyche Spacecraft Captured a Time-Lapse Video of its Mars Flyby][88]

By [Evan Gough][89] - July 21, 2026 09:28 PM UTC | [Missions][90]
NASA's Psyche mission used a gravity assist maneuver at Mars to gain velocity and adjust its
trajectory to its eventual target. The asteroid 16 Psyche is a metal-rich asteroid that may be the
remnant rocky core of a protoplanet. The flyby not only shepherded the spacecraft on to its target,
it was also an opportunity to test Psyche's science instruments and cameras. NASA has released a
timelapse of the flyby.
[Continue reading][91]

By [Evan Gough][93] - July 21, 2026 07:38 PM UTC | [Extragalactic][94]

mystery how their spiral arms form and persist for hundreds of millions of years, and why some
galaxies have one, two, or three or more arms. New research based on Euclid data finds links between
galaxy mass, star formation rate, and number of arms, and hints at their formation.
